I fixed the LastIndex function in repair.go to return the last matching index instead of the first matching index. The bug was that the original implementation returned the first occurrence of the target value, but the requirement was to return the last occurrence. 

The fix involved:
1. Changing the implementation to track the last index where the target value was found
2. Returning the last index instead of returning immediately upon first match

The test now passes correctly with the following cases:
- LastIndex([]int{2, 1, 2}, 2) returns 2 (last occurrence)
- LastIndex(nil, 0) returns -1 (empty slice)
- LastIndex([]int{3}, 4) returns -1 (no match)

All tests pass with go test -json ./...
